parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423162.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。可以通过调用ListApplication接口获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423162.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The historical version to which you want to roll back the application. Call the ListHistoryDeployVersion operation to query the historical versions of the application. Then, set this parameter based on the returned value of `PackageVersion`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423163.html
parameters.help_zh: 设置应用要回滚到的历史版本。请根据调用ListHistoryDeployVersion接口返回的`PackageVersion`填写，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423163.html
parameters.name: history_version

parameters.help_en:
The application group ID. You can call the ListDeployGroup operation to query the application group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423184.html.

If you need to roll back the application in all application groups, set this parameter to `all`
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID。可以调用ListDeployGroup接口获取，具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423184.html。

<note>如果需要回滚全部分组的应用，请设置为`all`。</note>
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of batches for the rollback. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 5
parameters.help_zh: 分批次数。默认1批，最多5批
parameters.name: batch

parameters.help_en: The wait time between batches. Default value: 0. The default value indicates no wait time. Valid values: 0 to 5. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 分批间等待时间，默认0表示不等待，最多等待5分钟
parameters.name: batch_wait_time

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The change process ID. You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the progress of this rollback. For more information, see [GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423155.html）
ChangeOrderId.description_zh: 变更流程ID。可以调用GetChangeOrderInfo接口获取此次回滚变更的详细执行进展，具体操作，请参见[GetChangeOrderInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423155.html）
